title: What If You Could See How Many People Have a Crush on You?
description:
What if you could see exactly how many people have a crush on you? 👀❤️

Imagine being a handsome guy with 0 admirers… while a tall, awkward-looking guy has 999+ people crushing on him. 💀

But what happens when you discover that attraction isn't as simple as you thought?

Would you want to know your number? 🤔

title: What If Only Two People Had to Repopulate the Earth?
description:
Eight billion people. Gone. In one second. Everyone on Earth disappears… except two.

Could just two people bring humanity back? How many kids would it take? How long until there's a city again? And what about the part nobody wants to talk about… the grandkids?

In this animated What If, we follow the last two humans on Earth: from the first silent night and the empty supermarkets, to the genetics of a family tree that folds back into itself, the bird that saved her entire species, and the math of rebuilding 8 billion people from scratch.

title: What If Your CRUSH Moved Into Your HOUSE?
tags: what if your crush moved in
what if your crush lived with you
description:
What if your crush moved into your house... for a whole month? 😳🏠

Chloe, the girl you've had a crush on since sophomore year, is standing in your bedroom. Her house had a major plumbing problem, so she and her mom are staying with you. 30 days. 720 hours. Of Chloe. In your house.

She steals your hoodies, eats your snacks, destroys you at video games and becomes your mom's favorite in less than 24 hours. Then her ex Ryan shows up with flowers, a photo of you two goes viral at school, and you remember one thing: she was never supposed to stay.

💬 Would YOU have told her how you felt? Tell me in the comments!

title: How to Survive When It Rains for 1 Year
tags: what if it rained for a year
description:
🌧️ **What if it rained nonstop for 365 DAYS?**

Imagine waking up tomorrow and discovering that the rain will not stop for an entire year.

At first, the streets flood. Then the electricity fails, drinking water becomes scarce, and food supplies begin disappearing. Within weeks, entire neighborhoods are underwater.

You're trapped on the 50th floor of a high-rise apartment building, watching the world below turn into an endless ocean.

Can you survive 365 days of nonstop rain?

In this cinematic animated-style survival story from Mr. DoomStick, you'll experience an extraordinary disaster through a second-person POV.

🌧️ What happens in this episode:
- Days 1–30: The rain begins, streets flood, and the building loses power.
- Days 31–90: Rescue attempts fail, and survival becomes increasingly difficult.
- Days 91–180: Food shortages, powerful storms, and damaged infrastructure threaten the survivors.
- Days 181–270: Emergency evacuations begin as the city becomes increasingly dangerous.
- Days 271–350: The journey inland brings new challenges and another devastating storm.
- Day 365: The rain finally stops. But what remains?

This is a fictional disaster-survival scenario exploring the challenges of extreme flooding, emergency preparedness, evacuation, and rebuilding.

🎬 **Watch until the end to discover what happens on Day 365.**

Subscribe to **Mr. DoomStick** for more cinematic POV survival stories, extreme disaster scenarios, and animated storytelling.

🔔 Subscribe: Mr.DoomStick

💬 **QUESTION:** If it rained nonstop for an entire year, what would be your biggest concern: drinking water, food, or finding a safe place to stay?

title: What If You Could See Everyone's Biggest Secret?
description:
What if you could see everyone’s biggest secret? 👁️ You look at a stranger, and suddenly you know something they’ve never told anyone. Then it happens with your best friend, your teacher, and your own family. Every face hides a story—and now you can see them all.

In this animated what-if scenario, we imagine everyday life with the power to uncover hidden truths: discovering unexpected crushes, private fears, and mistakes people wish they could forget. A normal conversation becomes a challenge when you know exactly what the other person is trying to hide.

Would you keep their secrets or speak up when someone could get hurt? Knowing one hidden fact wouldn’t mean you understood the whole story. Something that seemed suspicious might have an explanation—and revealing it could change a relationship forever. Could you help people without betraying their trust?

This mind-reading adventure explores privacy, honesty, and the unexpected responsibility of knowing too much. Would seeing everyone’s secrets bring you closer to people—or make it harder to look them in the eye?

title: What If You Were Reborn as Your Little Sister’s Baby?
description:
Tonight you’re fifteen, and you’re yelling at your little sister. She broke your headphones. You call her “Noodle.” She says she wishes you weren’t her brother. Two doors slam 🚪💥

You close your eyes for one second… and open them as a newborn 👶

The woman holding you has your sister’s face. Just eighteen years older. She’s your mom now. And she named you after yourself 😳

Then your best friend walks in. He’s your dad. Your parents walk in. They’re your grandparents. You’re one day old and you already need a nap

She kept your room exactly how you left it, and put your crib inside it. At night she whispers to you about her big brother, and the fight she never got to say sorry for. You cry. She thinks you’re hungry 🍼

So you try everything to tell her. Alphabet blocks that spell NOODLE (Marcus makes noodles). Your old school photo. Mashed peas (it looks like a duck). And the secret handshake nobody else ever knew… 🤜🤛

Your first word is the nickname only you ever called her. A plate hits the floor 🍽️

Years later, you shoot free throws the same weird way. You laugh the same snort. Your grandparents keep staring. And in your old desk drawer, you find a letter she wrote to her brother and never sent ✉️

If you got a second chance with someone you never said sorry to… what would you say first? ❤️

🔔 Subscribe so you don’t miss the next What If

title: What If You Could See How Everyone Rates You 1 to 10?
description:
You walk into school thinking you're a solid seven. Then you look closer. Above every head in the hallway there's a number: how that person rates you, right now, out of ten. Two. One and a half. Three. And under every number, a list of tips for how to become a ten.

What if you could see how everyone rates you? By lunch, the queen of the school is chasing you down the hallway. A lunch lady tries to give you her car. A physics teacher gives you an A-plus for one movie quote. By Saturday, a billionaire hands you a million dollars. Then one night, at his party, you meet a man whose number goes below zero, and his list of tips says only: ERROR. NO ACTION AVAILABLE.

What would your number be, and would you even want to know? Tell us in the comments.

Subscribe to DOOMPERK for more animated What If stories.

title: What If Every Girl on Earth Loved You?
description:
What if every girl on Earth loved you? 💘 You wake up to a phone full of messages, strangers recognise you everywhere, and a simple trip outside suddenly draws a crowd. At first, it feels like a dream—but what happens when you can’t get a moment to yourself?

In this animated what-if scenario, we imagine life with an impossible attraction power: endless invitations, awkward conversations, and notifications arriving faster than you can read them. From trying to spend time with friends to keeping your location private, ordinary life could become surprisingly complicated.

Would you enjoy the attention or search for a way to switch it off? Being loved by everyone wouldn’t mean you could return everyone’s feelings. And if their attraction came from a mysterious power, how would you know who would have chosen you without it?

This strange social superpower adventure explores popularity, privacy, relationships, and the difference between getting attention and building a real connection. With the whole world watching, could you still find someone who understands you?
